meta.conventions: hbar=c=1, cm, GeV; Lambda = sqrt(sigma), sigma = 50.68 GeV/cm (Lambda/keV)^2; qB = 2.998e-3 GeV/cm per T (unit charge); rho = gamma* beta*; l0 = m/sigma; l_max = 2(gamma*-1) l0; E* = gamma_cm beta_cm x B (pair rest frame); eps_perp = q|E*_perp|/sigma (component perpendicular to the initial CM axis n); alpha = angle(E*, n); default B = 3.8112 T, truth level, B only, T3 event sample (|eta_pair|<1, LO DY+ISR).
meta.tags: DERIVED = derived in the note and checked by sympy + limiting case; VERIFIED-NUM = derived and confirmed by targeted exact-NG runs; ESTIMATE = numerically determined constant or model step; CONJECTURE
